notes: Manufacturer spec sheet used as source. SDI in/out ports support 1.5G/3G/6G/12G-SDI (auto-switching); graded sdi-12g to reflect max supported rate. HDMI output is HDMI 2.0 (Type A). Ethernet is 10Gb/s RJ45 and also accepts Type 4 PoE for camera power (same physical RJ45 port, not a separate connector). USB-C x2 are 3.1 Gen 1 (5Gb/s) expansion ports for external SSD recording and network/USB tethering; marked bidirectional per host-port convention. The 3.5mm stereo jack doubles as a timecode input. Talkback output uses a 5-pin XLR headset connector (mapped to xlr5, closest match). Power input includes both a 12V DC locking 5.5mm barrel and a 4-pin XLR DC input for external battery/power supply (mapped to xlr4-dc). No AC/mains inlet on the camera body itself (DC/PoE powered only). The active Micro Four Thirds lens mount provides proprietary electronic lens control contacts, not a connector in the allowed list, so it is omitted from ports.
